hook: The Wage and Hour Division just dropped a major repeal attempt.

sections.voiceover: The Wage and Hour Division just dropped a major repeal attempt.
b_roll: U.S. Department of Labor seal on a federal building exterior

sections.voiceover: On October 7, 2026, the Wage and Hour Division published a notice. Nine parts of longstanding Fair Labor Standards Act guidance faced removal from the Code of Federal Regulations. Why did the Department of Labor reverse course?
b_roll: Code of Federal Regulations open on a wooden desk
Document pages showing federal register citations

sections.voiceover: Max Kutner revealed that July 2025 proposal targeted nine parts of guidance.
b_roll: Federal Register publication volume open on a table

sections.voiceover: Max Kutner confirmed the cancellation in Law360. Officials officially dropped page 28985 of volume 90. Wage guidelines remain fully protected inside the Code of Federal Regulations.
b_roll: Law360 news article displayed on a laptop screen
Code of Federal Regulations binding close-up

sections.voiceover: Check Law360 for updates on the Code of Federal Regulations.
b_roll: U.S. Department of Labor building entrance
